reader_summary.overview: One of the biggest misconceptions around network effects (which are one of the key dynamics behind many successful and highly defensible software companies) is confusing growth with engagement.. So how does one tell the difference between viral growth and network effects? How does one create network effects in different businesses?

key_points.text: One of the biggest misconceptions around network effects (which are one of the key dynamics behind many successful and highly defensible software companies) is confusing growth with engagement..
And what are some examples of teasing all of the above apart?
